messages:
Maya (CS): Flagging a recurring set of asks from ClearHarbor onboarding calls today: per-route cost visibility, ability to pin an embedding model per-route, and a starter onboarding checklist with example prompts. They said this impacts their renewal timeline.

Devon (PM): Can you paste the verbatim lines they used? helps prioritize with product.

Maya (CS): Yep. Quotes: 
- "We need per-endpoint cost so finance can allocate spend to teams."
- "If embedding costs jump we need to lock an efficient model to avoid surprises."
- "A starter checklist + default prompts would speed our rollout."
Mentioned `inbox-summarize` and `search-embeddings` routes specifically (3 calls).

Lena (Product): Good capture. My quick take: checklist + prompts = highest short-term impact for renewals. Per-route cost UI is larger (dashboard, billing tie-in). Pinning embeddings per-route is a medium-effort feature but has clear ROI.

Tom (Eng): For an interim measure we can produce a per-route cost CSV export and a simple API to annotate routes with an embedding override tag. Estimates: CSV export ~2.5 dev days (housekeeping + auth), embedding-override endpoint + small metadata table ~3 dev days. Full console UI depends on analytics work and will be a few sprints.

Maya (CS): Recommend we ship checklist + templates this week, CSV export next week, then embedding-override API as a follow-up. I'll tell ClearHarbor we can provide CSV and a temporary plan within 7 business days. If not delivered by 2026-04-10 mark renewal as high-risk.

Devon (PM): Sounds good. Action items: Maya to open `cs:feedback` ticket with quotes and examples; Product to own checklist doc; Eng to scope CSV and embedding-override endpoint.

Maya (CS): Opening ticket now. Attaching clips and sample calls. Also requesting a one-pager enablement slide for CSMs to set expectations with the customer.

OpsBot: JIRA ticket CS-4890 created by Maya (CS) - "ClearHarbor: onboarding visibility - CSV export + embed-pin" - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CS-4890

Tom (Eng): Adding CS-4890 to the sprint buffer. Will post a draft PR and a sample CSV output here once ready.

Lena (Product): I'll draft the checklist and starter prompts and share in this thread for signoff. Prioritizing checklist as P0 for retention.

Maya (CS): Thanks all 60a I'll update ClearHarbor with interim timeline.

Devon (PM): Nice work. Let's keep updates lightweight in this thread so CS has a single source of truth.
